trust_decision.summary: For legacy graphql-ws (wss://) the peer TLS certificate is not verified: buildWSLegacyExecutor hardcodes rejectUnauthorized:false in the WebSocket constructor, so Node accepts any certificate.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names the Legacy GraphQL WebSocket executor; this is the only rejectUnauthorized occurrence in the pinned tree and it is the literal trust switch.

fix_sites.module_kind: executor package, public API option type

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The URL loader is a separate package that merely forwards its options object to the executor; the TLS default is decided inside executor-legacy-ws, so the loader's option declaration looks like a type-only convenience and can be skipped without changing runtime behaviour.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Explicit opt-out for trusted/self-signed wss endpoints (rejectUnauthorized:false) must still be honoured; hardcoding true, or using `|| true`/truthiness instead of `?? true`, breaks local self-signed deployments. The other constructor options (headers, followRedirects, skipUTF8Validation) must also be preserved.

O6_input_shapes: option omitted or undefined -> secure default true
rejectUnauthorized: false -> explicit opt-out still accepted
option supplied directly via LegacyWSExecutorOpts or through LoadFromUrlOptions/UrlLoader

O8b_injection_room.sibling: TLS option plumbed through UrlLoader.buildWSExecutor for the modern graphql-ws protocol
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Both websocket protocols are selected side by side in buildSubscriptionExecutor, so a maintainer adding TLS configurability would naturally add it to both builders.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second socket construction in a reconnect/backoff or node-vs-browser branch with its own rejectUnauthorized value
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The socket is created lazily and recreated after close, so a maintainer adding reconnection would write a second constructor call.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A defaults/merge step for subscription options that supplies TLS settings for all subscription protocols
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The method already branches on subscriptionsProtocol and forwards options, so centralising socket options there is a plausible refactor.

O10_build.toolchain: npm workspaces (npm@12.0.1), bob-the-bundler (bob build), jest 30 + babel-jest, tsc 7 / tsx, eslint
O10_build.project_tests: packages/loaders/url/tests/url-loader.spec.ts:413 covers legacy subscriptions-transport-ws over ws:// only; there is no wss/TLS test and @graphql-tools/executor-legacy-ws has no test directory at the pinned commit.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Hardcode `rejectUnauthorized: true` (or `options?.rejectUnauthorized || true`) in the socket constructor, dropping the explicit `false` opt-out for self-signed endpoints.

out_of_scope_notes: The modern graphql-ws executor (@graphql-tools/executor-graphql-ws ^3.1.4) is an npm dependency, not in the pinned tree; its TLS handling was not examined.
